name: 02-upload-text-file
description: POST multipart part 'file' (test.txt): status 200, body is the file content, file written as <upload dir>/test.txt.

source.reference: http-multipart-request/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/HttpMultpartRequestIT.java (uploads src/test/resources/test.txt, content 'file uploaded', asserts the file exists under /tmp); http-multipart-request/src/main/app/http-multipart-request.xml (expression-component extracts filename from Content-Disposition; set-payload dataSource.content; file:outbound-endpoint path=/tmp outputPattern=#[attachmentFileName]; http:response-builder statusCode=200)

request.body:
--PARITYBOUNDARY
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="test.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

file uploaded
--PARITYBOUNDARY--
